mandatory_defects.title: Cursor scope collapses queries that canonical ranking treats differently

evidence.observation: Requires canonical normalize/match scoring but binds scope_digest to the normalized effective query.
normalize casefolds all text, while tokens splits CamelCase before casefold.
query_text preserves case after trimming, exact stable-ID matching compares the original query, and ranked uses those match results.
Canonical record IDs permit upper- and lowercase local characters.
Canonical search order must be preserved and an incompatible query must not resume another result sequence.

mandatory_defects.counterexample: ProjectDirector and projectdirector have the same normalize() value but tokens() yields {project,director} versus {projectdirector}. Similarly, a mixed-case exact URN and its casefolded spelling can change stable_id matching. With all other request fields equal, the proposed scope digest accepts the original cursor while the effective match set or ordering can change, allowing skipped or repeated identities. This is a static counterexample from the inspected functions, not an executed runtime test.
mandatory_defects.required_correction: Bind the cursor scope to every ranking-relevant query input: retain the exact query_text result in addition to the normalized query (or an explicitly equivalent complete canonical match-input representation). Preserve original-case exact-ID and tokenization semantics. State that a request whose effective raw query differs is cursor_scope unless equivalence is actually established; do not lowercase the query passed to match. Add contract examples for CamelCase and case-distinct stable IDs.

mandatory_defects.title: Strict limits configuration lacks its exact property names and numeric domains

evidence.observation: Unknown configuration properties are rejected, top-level limits is {}, and limits is said to accept only numeric settings enumerated below.
The table supplies human resource labels and ceilings but no JSON key names, integer/real domains or valid lower bounds for limits settings.
The context response references Category without an exact Category wire declaration, while the same section is called exact operation schemas.
Exact request/envelope/error/cursor shapes and numeric limits must be frozen before consumer implementation.

mandatory_defects.impact: Two independent implementers can choose incompatible keys such as request_bytes versus request_body_bytes, different minimums (including zero workers/pages), or different Category response members while both follow this proposal. The strict schema and client validators are therefore not yet a single frozen contract.
mandatory_defects.required_correction: Add a concrete limits property table or schema with every permitted JSON key, exact numeric type, minimum, default, hard maximum and canonical-clamping relationship; identify which resource ceilings are fixed service internals and therefore not configurable. Define the Category response fields explicitly, and provide the exact bounds/validation source for shared ID/hash/session/cursor scalar types instead of leaving those wire declarations open. Preserve all current upper ceilings and unknown-key rejection.

mandatory_defects.title: The root-specific preference identity required by the frontend is unavailable at context load

evidence.observation: Exact context data lists name, purpose, namespace, starting entries, categories, capabilities, available filters, local additions and build ID; there is no root identity digest or preference namespace.
The shared envelope project object is only id and namespace; no other envelope field supplies this digest.
Preferences must use API version, canonical project/namespace and a server-provided root identity digest.
root_digest appears only inside a continuation cursor, which need not exist for an initial context or empty/single-page project.
Different selected projects must demonstrate isolated preferences, routes, caches, sources and sessions.

mandatory_defects.impact: The frontend cannot form its mandated preference key after an initial context read without an undeclared endpoint/field or decoding an optional continuation token. Falling back to project ID/namespace alone loses the contract distinction between separate roots with the same identity.
mandatory_defects.required_correction: Add an explicit non-sensitive stable preference namespace or root digest to the authenticated context response and its validator. Specify derivation and lifetime across service restart, snapshot change and root change, with no raw absolute path disclosure. State that the client uses that field directly and does not derive identity from cursors.
